faq.q: What is the origin of Oumou?
faq.a: Oumou is associated with Arabic. Oumou is the West African form of Arabic أُمّ (umm), meaning 'mother', used as a female given name.
Yes — the underlying form أُمُّ is Arabic.
Oumou can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
